observations: body L2: in the head the dash after «a)» measures 9.7 pt and is transcribed as a dash; that of «11-20» measures 3.6 pt, a hyphen; no full stop follows.
body L4: the d after 93 is printed without its bowl, like an l.
body L5-L7: 178d 14 1/2h + 186d 14 3/4h = 365d 5 1/4h, and al-Battānī's year of 365d 5h 46m 24s (L8) exceeds this by 31m 24s.
body L10, L13: the dashes of «al–Battānī» are long dashes (5.4 pt).
body L19: twelve hours from the solstice the Sun is 0°,49 from it in longitude, and its declination is smaller by 3″,3 (with ε = 23° 35′), as Schiaparelli says.
body L22: in 31m 24s the Sun moves 1′ 17″ in mean motion.
body L10, L23: heavy brackets open and close Schiaparelli's addition; the dash before his name measures 9.4 pt.

body (table): the table is boxed by double rules, the head separated from the rows by a thin rule; the head is in small capitals. The days are counted from 0 January: 74d,9046 is 15 March 21h 42m,6, and so on, all right except the summer solstice of 883, where 168d,6580 is 17 June 15h 47m,5, printed «15 46 5» without the comma.
notes_left L1-L4: «93d 14m» is printed for 93d 14h: the 16″ between 92° 14′ 10″ and 92° 14′ 26″ take the Sun 6m,5, the difference between 93d 14h and 93d 13h 53m,5.
notes_left L1: the print sets no rule over the notes, under the table.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
